gap_records.summary: Required candidate file for `native_godot_project` is unverified.

task_specification.objective: Complete the survival-foundation camera, movement, and dash increment while simultaneously delivering the required authored weapon/upgrade choice hierarchy and arena spatial integrity, with deterministic lifecycle reset and evidence-ready authoritative state.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has partial movement, dash, camera, spatial-contract, and upgrade-card implementations, but the survival-foundation contract is still unverified as one integrated player-facing loop. The remaining integration risk is at input/context handoff, lifecycle reset, collision/framing alignment, and choice presentation binding rather than a proven isolated subsystem failure.

stop_conditions: Do not expand into unrelated combat, boss, dense-performance, audio, or decorative asset work.
Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and accepted coupled assets; do not destructively edit, split, duplicate, or replace them without explicit incompatibility evidence.
Stop after focused candidate implementation and self-validation are complete; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own host recapture, qualitative judgment, and closure.

strategy.rationale: Repair the authoritative player, camera, input-router, run-state, spatial-contract, and choice-view seams as one stateful integration boundary. Use lifecycle-safe state ownership and authored collision/visibility bindings instead of transform-only compensation, while keeping the existing authored environment intact.

code: Run parser/static checks and focused tests for WardenController, ArenaCamera, InputContextRouter, run lifecycle/reset, CemeterySpatialContract, and UpgradeDraftView.
Verify InputMap coverage for movement, dash, ui_accept, ui_cancel, and navigation across keyboard, mouse, and gamepad, including duplicate-edge rejection and held-confirm debounce.

White-box inspect snapshots/signals for authoritative movement source, planar velocity, dash phase transitions, cooldown, invulnerability, camera safe-frame/occlusion state, arena collision extents, guidance completion, choice current/new values, focus device, and reset generation.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime recaptures validate:survival_foundation_camera_movement_dash_contract with movement_effect_capture and page_state_probe at spawn, ordinary movement, dash onset/active/recovery/cooldown, central landmark, perimeter/boundary, pause/resume, choice focus, death/retry, and three restart baselines.

Tester verifies camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, high-angle framing, bounded dash/invulnerability/cooldown, clean pause/resume, and no hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input, or FPS/TPS camera drift.

Tester verifies the contextual first-run guidance and the authored choice hierarchy with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, truthful current-to-new deltas, debounced confirmation, and clean retry/reset; Tester owns pass/fail and issue-ledger updates.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay views at spawn, a critical route, central building/landmark traversal, and perimeter/boundary traversal; compare arena scale, external depth/world, escape lanes, collision alignment, and disappearance/occlusion behavior with the PRD and bound Mournlight reference.

Capture the choice page in keyboard-focus, mouse-hover, gamepad-focus, changed-selection, and unavailable states at native and supported UI scales; verify silhouettes/icons lead, stat rows are compact and truthful, no more than three deltas are shown, and no generic text-stacked card remains.

done_when: WASD and gamepad left-stick input produce camera-relative planar movement with stable facing, collision sliding, no stuck input, and a high-angle camera that keeps the player, nearby threats, pickups, projectiles, and an escape lane readable.

Space and the gamepad south-face action each trigger exactly one bounded anticipation, active, recovery, and cooldown sequence with visible feedback, a short invulnerability window, declared readiness, and deterministic clearing on release, death, pause, retry, and reset.

The authored arena has a larger traversable scale and coherent external world/external depth; the central building/landmark and perimeter/boundary have aligned collision and remain visible during ordinary movement/movement replay with no pass-through, disappearance, or camera occlusion drift.

Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy led by weapon/upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, no NEW or LOCKED placeholder in CURRENT, no unchanged or exhaustive rows, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.

First-run guidance briefly teaches movement, dash, automatic attack, pickup collection, and the first upgrade in the real arena; it is dismissible without consuming combat input, does not reappear on retry, and remains discoverable through help.

A black-box replay verifies title-to-run, pause/resume, movement, dash, choice focus/confirm/cancel, death/retry, and three restart baselines; authoritative snapshots expose movement source, dash phase/cooldown/invulnerability, camera visibility state, collision extents, choice values/focus device, and reset generation.
tasks.instructions: Inspect and implement the existing authoritative seams in scripts/player/warden_controller.gd, scripts/camera/arena_camera.gd, scripts/world/cemetery_spatial_contract.gd, scripts/input/input_context_router.gd, scripts/gameplay/survival_foundation.gd, scripts/gameplay/run_controller.gd, scripts/gameplay/run_snapshot.gd, scripts/ui/run_hud.gd, scripts/ui/run_shell.gd, and scripts/ui/upgrade_draft.gd with their bound scenes. Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with silhouettes/icons, a clear visual hierarchy, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states. Source all displayed values from authoritative build data and omit unchanged, unrelated, NEW, and LOCKED current-value rows. Keep AuthoredCemeteryPackage as the sole visual environment; use only additive outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn, and objective anchors. Ensure the larger traversable scale, external world/external depth, central building/landmark, collision, disappearance/occlusion behavior, perimeter/boundary, and ordinary movement/movement replay are all aligned and inspectable. Make context transitions release movement/dash latches safely, keep clocks and pause ownership authoritative, and reset dash, velocity, camera compositor/occlusion, focus, guidance, timers, pooled actors, and result flags on retry. Add only candidate-owned snapshots or tester-only preparation hooks needed for recapture, guarded out of release exports.
tasks.title: Integrate camera-relative movement, bounded dash, arena integrity, and authored choice hierarchy
